CMOS first-order sigma-delta modulator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCM vcm 0 1.65
VB vb 0 .9
VLO vlo 0 1.0
VHI vhi 0 2.3
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 1.35 200u 1.35 200.1u 1.65 400u 1.65 400.1u 1.95 600u 1.95)
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 .5u 1n 1n .499u 1u)
VR reset 0 PWL(0 3.3 2u 3.3 2.001u 0 600u 0)
XDUT vdd 0 vcm vb vin ramp cmp q clk reset vlo vhi astra_080_cmos_first_order_sigma_delta
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec den0 range 0.22423077000000002 0.31423077 unit=dimensionless
* @spec den1 range 0.455 0.545 unit=dimensionless
* @spec den2 range 0.68576923 0.7757692300000001 unit=dimensionless
* @spec ramp_lo range 0.5 1.65 unit=V
* @spec ramp_hi range 1.65 2.8 unit=V
* @spec sum_bias range 1.6 1.7 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5n 600u
let density=v(q)/3.3
meas tran den0 AVG density FROM=100u TO=190u
meas tran den1 AVG density FROM=300u TO=390u
meas tran den2 AVG density FROM=500u TO=590u
meas tran ramp_lo MIN v(ramp) FROM=100u TO=590u
meas tran ramp_hi MAX v(ramp) FROM=100u TO=590u
meas tran sum_bias AVG v(xdut.sum) FROM=100u TO=190u
write out.raw v(q) v(ramp) v(xdut.sum) v(vin)
quit
.endc
.end
